t_advice_summary_textbox.text: test the groups to establish best performer, repeat when the values decrease.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 sets of gnomes each with seperate baskets (green, yellow, orang brown with a red basket and pink, purple red and blue with a gold basket) One basket will get more mushrooms so focus on that basket for a start when high. It will start to drop in value so start on the other and test between until you notice higher yield.
